reason: The primitive orthorhombic cell is strongly supported by peak positions, but exact structure recovery is not established. No comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied, and the trajectory reports only about 7.8-9.1% residuals for unconstrained line-intensity fits while explicitly acknowledging unresolved atomic phase/order. The submitted P1 models have chemically untenable short contacts (including Ni-Sn near 1.34-1.47 A and Sn-Sn near 1.36-1.65 A), and the P-1 alternative is still less physical, with 0.42 A contacts and a density of about 11.66 g/cm3. Thus the cell/average diffraction lattice has support, but Z, symmetry, coordinates, and element ordering do not; a chemically constrained, materially different solution attempt is warranted.
